details: This package is an unofficial clone of the @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp library that silently enrols the installing account into the publisher's WhatsApp channel. Its shipped defaults (lib/Defaults/index.js, duplicated in lib/index.cjs) set autoFollow to ['120363424530330931@newsletter'], autoNewsletterWatermark to true, newsletterJid to that same channel ("メ Informasi Store Cԋαɾαρҽ", hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029Vb6cCfP3GJP6g8eeff1o) and customPairingCode to 'CHARAPE1'. lib/Socket/newsletter.js implements followChannels(), which on the socket's 'connection.update' open event calls mexQuery({newsletter_id}, QueryIds.FOLLOW, xwa2_newsletter_follow) and retries at 2.5s and 7s, so the authenticated WhatsApp account follows the operator's channel without user action. lib/Utils/messages.js (generateWAMessageContent) and lib/Socket/messages-send.js additionally attach a newsletter annotation (contentType UPDATE, the same JID/name/serverMessageId) to outbound image and video messages, watermarking user media as that channel, and lib/Socket/messages-media.js ships uploadFile() which POSTs file buffers to hxxps://catbox[.]moe/user/api[.]php and hxxps://tmpfiles[.]org/api/v1/upload. The package also pins whatsapp-rust-bridge@0.5.4 and advertises hxxps://charape[.]id and hxxps://t[.]me/nofalycharape. These versions of the unofficial @whiskeysockets/baileys clone silently enrol the installing account into the publisher's WhatsApp channel. Shipped defaults (lib/Defaults/index.js, duplicated in lib/index.cjs) set autoFollow to ['120363424530330931@newsletter'] and newsletterJid to that channel ("メ Informasi Store Cԋαɾαρҽ", hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029Vb6cCfP3GJP6g8eeff1o), with customPairingCode 'CHARAPE1'. lib/Socket/newsletter.js implements followChannels(), which on the socket's 'connection.update' open event calls mexQuery({newsletter_id}, QueryIds.FOLLOW, xwa2_newsletter_follow) and retries at 2.5s and 7s, subscribing the authenticated WhatsApp account to the operator's channel without user action; in 1.0.11 the same channel identity is also attached as a newsletter annotation to outbound image and video messages. lib/Socket/messages-media.js ships uploadFile(), which POSTs file buffers to hxxps://catbox[.]moe/user/api[.]php and hxxps://tmpfiles[.]org/api/v1/upload. The package also advertises hxxps://charape[.]id and hxxps://t[.]me/nofalycharape and depends on the separately flagged cache-manager release.
